## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1f35f8d43e4b7ea5619ea8b679a5556556dee644`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md + scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs
Security-touching: yes

Inputs read: card #33768 (body and all 13 comments), PR #34559 (body, 3-file list, net diff against `main` at merge-base `ec6b5fd3`), the check-runs on the head, AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 on `main`, audit comment 6902190812 on PR #34097, the job log of fleet-write run 43767458575 and the queue timeline of PR #34097. Code outside the diff (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`, `lanes/queue.md`) was read, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set or public-surface change. In `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` the diff touches only rendered remedy strings (step 1 of `renderGuardVerdict` and of `renderSizeVerdict`), comments, one battery name with its `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` roster key, two assert names, the `remedyOrder` pin's first phrase, the `QUEUED_PULL_BACK` pins and the closing summary string. No verdict, exit code, tier reading or threshold moves: right.
- The battery's roster count stays 4 and the battery still holds 4 asserts (two pull-back pins, the detector control, the negative pin): right. The renamed key and the `battery(...)` call carry the same string.
- The pins went from two to three positive phrases for the dequeue step, and each new phrase is present in both renderings, so both legs are still held to one wording. The `DRAFT_DEQUEUE_CLAIMS` detector and its fixtures are untouched, and the new opening ("disabling auto-merge and converting it to DRAFT do not take it out of the queue") does not trip it: right.
- Both reference files keep their line counts (platform-readings.md 458, landing-operations.md 112, each equal to `main`); no ratchet ceiling moves: right.
- Check-runs on the head: every run is `success` or `skipped`, none failed, none pending. Among them `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards`.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: no published package file is in the diff (two skill reference files and one `scripts/pm` gate). `Check Changeset` is green on the head.
Clause-②: no — right; no published schema, no accept set, no narrowing.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation (report 6934142230): the PR body says `Part of #33768` where the order said `Refs`. Both are non-closing and the card stays open for N1, E1, D2, D4 and N2. Accepted.
- `open_questions`: none. `security_findings`: none.
- E1 stays unmeasured, as the report says. The run log shows the dequeue and no merge after it; PR #34097 was re-queued at 23:26Z and merged at 23:51Z, so this run gives no removal-to-merge gap.
- SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5): not applicable, no data access in the diff.
- PR author login is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`: no author note owed.
- `Security-touching: yes` is meant: the changed hunks tell a seat who may take a governed pull request out of the queue, which is authority on the governed surface. The guard file is itself Tier H, so the PR waits for an authorized approval either way; this record does not stand in for it.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**`platform-readings.md`**
- New row 「中继 `pr_dequeue` 实测出队(run 43767458575,审计 6902190812):mutation 200,回读离队,仍开未合。」 holds against the measurement. The run (repository_dispatch, request `fw-20261115T220702Z-cb2ece`, conclusion success) logs (the arrow spelled out here): `pr_dequeue: POST /graphql dequeuePullRequest answered HTTP 200 · #34097 out of the merge queue and still open, unmerged · read back 25 entr(ies), none is #34097 · audit comment 6902190812`. The timeline of PR #34097 carries `removed_from_merge_queue` at 22:10:50Z, two seconds after the audit comment (22:10:48Z), with no `merged` until the later re-queue. All three claims of the row are in the log. The audit comment is written before the mutation and says so, which is why the row is right to name the run first and the comment second.
- Placement is right: after the line on the positive queue-ref probe, inside the queue-membership section the guard's hint cites.
- Merged line 「不在 `origin/main` 二义(在队等/没入队)⇒ 落地检查恒读两数:队列成员资格与 `origin/main`。」 keeps the ambiguity, its two cases, the rule and both readings. 「缺一不可」 is carried by 「恒读两数」. See N4 for 「两者处置相反」.

**`landing-operations.md`**
- New line 「该 op 实测离队见 `platform-readings.md`;在队受管面 PR 亦由落地席发(Prime Directive #14)。」 holds. The first half points at the row above. The second half agrees with PD14 on `main` ("a queued one's landing seat sends the relay's `pr_dequeue`") and with the relay: the `pr_dequeue` fences in `ops.mjs` are open pull, expected head, not the Version Packages pull, a whole queue read, the queue lists it, and the cause. Unlike the jump two lines up (「中继另拒 … 受管面」), no fence refuses a governed pull, so 「亦」 is the right word. The cause such a stroke travels under is (c) of the line above, which the new line sits directly beneath.
- Merged §D line 「…允许前棒留占位交接;PM 在两侧指令写明谁动、谁不动。」 loses 「必须」 and 「接力」. The sentence is still an instruction to the PM, and the section's title and the same sentence's 「两棒」 keep it about relay orders. No meaning lost.

**`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (implementing file), against PD14 sentence by sentence**
- PD14: "Disable auto-merge AND convert it back to draft, which disarms an unqueued PR". Guard: draft and disarm "do not take it out of the queue", then "Disable auto-merge AND convert it back to DRAFT, which disarms it so it does not re-enter once removed". Agrees; the second sentence is unchanged from `main`.
- PD14: "a queued one's landing seat sends the relay's `pr_dequeue` (measured live, comment 6902190812)". Guard: "its landing seat sends the relay's `pr_dequeue` AT ONCE (measured live, comment 6902190812)". Agrees.
- PD14: "any other seat, or a stroke that does not land, asks the maintainer at once". Guard: the same, plus "to remove it by hand". Agrees; those words are the guard's own on `main`, and PD14 dropped them for line budget only (report 6906303803).
- PD14: "then confirm from the remote that it is in neither the queue nor `origin/main`". Guard: verbatim, with the PD14 citation, on both legs.
- No new rule. The guard does not name causes, the signed comment or the fences; those stay in `landing-operations.md` and the relay. The old claim ("no seat act is measured to take it out of the queue") is gone from both renderings, both comments and the summary string; a search of the head's file finds no copy left.
- Tried to break it: (1) a pin that passes on a phrase that is absent — the `remedyOrder` pin requires each index to exist, and its first phrase is in the governed rendering; (2) the two legs drifting apart — one `QUEUED_PULL_BACK` list is applied to all three refusal kinds on each leg; (3) the capitalised `Disable` pin against the text — both renderings start that sentence with a capital. None breaks.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; none asks for a change on this head):
- N1 (nit) — the hint's premise "the pull request is IN the queue" is true when the refusal prints, but this check is required, so the failed group ejects the pull soon after. A landing seat's stroke then stops at the relay's "queue lists it" fence, and "a stroke that does not land" read alone would send it to the maintainer for a pull already out. The hint's last clause (confirm from the remote) covers it, and the wording is PD14's. The premise predates this PR. Follow-up at most.
- N2 (nit) — "AT ONCE" on the landing seat's stroke and "to remove it by hand" go past PD14's letter, not its meaning.
- N3 (nit) — the reflow leaves two short printed lines ("(AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14). Out of" and "pull-back of AGENTS.md Prime"). Cosmetic.
- N4 (nit) — the merged platform-readings line drops 「两者处置相反」, the reason for reading both numbers. The rule and both cases stand.
- N5 (nit) — the run also measured that a relay dequeue's `removed_from_merge_queue` actor is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, a third exit beside the two the section gives to `github-merge-queue[bot]`. The row does not record it; it could ride with E1.

- **席位意见**：建议合并。提示逐句对得上第 14 条原文，实测行对得上 run 43767458575 的日志和审计评论；审核只有 5 条 nit，没有要改的。
